messages:
maya: Quick thread to finalize release notes + internal blurb for tomorrow's rollout. Change window: 02:00-04:00 UTC. Need: final copy, pinning decision, canary owner, and rollback snippet.

sean: LGTM overall. For pinning I want prod pinned to model v2.3.1 and a fallback to v2.2.9. If we see regressions we should be able to pin back within the window.

lucas: I'll own the canary. Plan: 5% for 30m, if healthy -> 25% for 30m -> full. Health = 99% success rate + latency < 120ms p95. If any check fails, we /rollout cancel and pin back.

maya: Deploy-bot, schedule the canary for 02:00 UTC tomorrow and post updates to #eng-releases.

deploy-bot: Scheduled by @lucas: canary start 1854306000 (02:00 UTC). Canary stages: 5% (30m) -> 25% (30m) -> 100%. Hooks: on-error -> automatic rollback candidate; manual commands: `/rollout cancel`, `/rollout promote`, `/models pin`. Notifications will post here and to #eng-oncall.

kim: Draft internal blurb below — please skim and edit. I kept it short for the company-wide pinned message. Add runbook link and rollback commands?

kim: "Heads up — we will roll out model v2.3.1 to production during the 02:00–04:00 UTC change window tomorrow. This is a staged rollout (5% -> 25% -> 100%). Expected user impact: none; p95 latency may increase by up to ~15ms for high-context requests. If you see issues, contact eng-oncall or follow the rollback runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/release-rollback. Updates will be posted in #eng-releases."

elaine: tiny wording nit — add the pin instruction so support knows what to do: `pin to v2.2.9` example. Also clarify that embeddings / batch jobs are excluded from the canary.

maya: Good call. Final copy below (ready to post to #general and email to CS):

maya: "Planned rollout: model v2.3.1 — Change window 02:00–04:00 UTC. Staged rollout: 5% (30m) -> 25% (30m) -> 100%. Embeddings and scheduled batch jobs are excluded. Expected impact: no functional change; p95 latency change up to +15ms on high-context paths. If you observe degraded quality or errors, follow the rollback steps in the runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/release-rollback. For immediate rollback: run `/rollout cancel` then `/models pin prod text-gen v2.2.9`. We will post live updates in #eng-releases. @eng-oncall will be paged on anomalies."

sean: +1 :thumbsup: Good to send. Make sure product comms get the "what changed" bullet (short list).

kim: Adding a 3-item "what changed" to the announcement: 1) attention optimization tweaks, 2) kv cache retention improvement, 3) quantization parameter fixes.

lucas: I'll attach the canary dashboard and the temporary pin command here when the canary starts. Also I'll keep the rollback window open for 45m after full rollout.

maya: Approved. I'll post the internal announcement at 22:00 UTC today to give CS and support time to review. Posting copy in #eng-releases and sending to the CS mailing list.

lucas: I'll be online during the window and watching telemetry.

elaine: Thanks everyone — one more ask: can we include the expected token-cost delta in the release notes? Support sometimes gets questions about billing.

maya: Good point. Kim, can you add a small cost note?

kim: Added: "Expected unit cost impact: +2–4% on text-gen tokens for affected endpoints."

maya: Perfect. I'll publish the announcement and pin the runbook link. :rocket:
